title: Semi-modales: have to / ought to / need to / had better / be supposed to
instructions: Elegí la opción correcta. Recordá: los semi-modales llevan to (excepto had better).

items.q: She ___ submit the report by Friday. It's a company rule.

must to: después de un modal no va to: must submit. Y la frase pide semi-modal: has to.
have to: she es 3.ª persona singular: has to.

items.q: You ___ see a doctor.

ought: ought siempre lleva to: ought to see.
oughts to: ought to no lleva -s: ought to see.
are ought to: ought to no se usa con be: ought to see.

items.q: I ___ fix this bug before the demo.

needs to: I no lleva -s: need to fix.
must to: después de must no va to: must fix. La frase pide need to.

items.q: You ___ back up the database before running that migration, or you'll have problems.

had better to: después de had better va el verbo base, sin to: had better back up.
have better: la expresión fija es had better (con had).
had best to: la expresión fija es had better, y sin to: had better back up.

items.q: The deployment ___ happen at midnight, according to the plan.
items.e: be supposed to = se supone que.

supposes to: la expresión es be supposed to (con be y -ed): is supposed to.
supposed to: falta el verbo be: is supposed to.

items.q: Will you ___ attend the meeting tomorrow?
items.e: will + be able to (can no se combina con will).

can: después de will no va un modal más: will be able to.
could to: después de un modal no va to; y después de will: be able to.

items.q: She ___ fix the bug yet.
items.e: Present Perfect de be able to.

can't been able to: can't no se combina con been able to; con yet (presente perfecto): hasn't been able to.
isn't able: falta to (isn't able to); y con yet se usa el presente perfecto: hasn't been able to.
hasn't able to: falta been: hasn't been able to.

items.q: You ___ worry about the deadline.
items.e: don't need TO (o needn't sin to).

needn't to: needn't no lleva to: needn't worry. La forma con to es don't need to.
don't need: falta to: don't need to worry.
mustn't: mustn't = prohibido; acá es 'no hace falta preocuparse': don't need to.

items.q: I ___ code in jQuery. Now I use React.
items.e: Hábito pasado que ya no existe.

am used to: am used to + -ing = estoy acostumbrado; acá es un hábito pasado que ya no existe: used to.
would: would sirve para hábitos pasados repetidos y I would code in jQuery se oye bien, pero el ejercicio es de semi-modales y contrasta con Now I use React (ya no): used to.
use to: use to (sin d) va con did/didn't; en afirmativa: used to.

items.q: He ___ be here today. It's his day off.

doesn't suppose to: la expresión es be supposed to (con be y -ed): isn't supposed to.
hadn't better to: hadn't better no se usa así y no lleva to; la idea es 'no se supone que': isn't supposed to.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:

has to + verbo; falta to: has to go.
she es 3.ª persona singular: has to.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
Elegí la correcta:

después de had better va el verbo base, sin to: had better leave.
después de had better va el verbo base: leave.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:

ought to no lleva -s: ought to go.
después de ought to va el verbo base: ought to go.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:

dos modales juntos y must no lleva -s: have to go.
después de must no va to y el orden está mal: you have to go.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:

después de doesn't va el verbo base: doesn't have to.
el negativo de have to se arma con do: doesn't have to.

title: Passive Voice: presente y futuro
instructions: Elegí la forma pasiva correcta. Fórmula: auxiliar del tiempo + be/been/being + participio.

items.q: User passwords ___ in an encrypted database.
items.e: Las contraseñas RECIBEN la acción → pasiva: are + participio.

store: store es activo; las contraseñas son guardadas (pasivo): are stored.
have stored: have stored es activo (Present Perfect); la pasiva es be + participio: are stored.
are storing: are storing es activo; las contraseñas reciben la acción: are stored.

items.q: A new version of the software ___ next week.

will release: will release es activo; la versión es lanzada (pasivo): will be released.
is released: is released es presente; next week pide futuro: will be released.
will be release: después de be va el participio: will be released.

items.q: The database ___ automatically every night.
items.e: Rutina + la base de datos recibe la acción → is backed up.

backs up: backs up es activo; la base de datos recibe la acción (pasivo): is backed up.
is backing up: is backing up es activo continuo; hace falta pasivo: is backed up.
has backed up: has backed up es activo; hace falta pasivo: is backed up.

items.q: The project ___ at the moment because the requirements are being reviewed.
items.e: 'at the moment' → Continuous pasivo: is being + participio.

is delayed: is delayed es presente simple pasivo; at the moment pide continuo: is being delayed.
was delayed: was delayed es pasado; at the moment pide presente continuo: is being delayed.
has delayed: has delayed es activo; hace falta pasivo continuo: is being delayed.

items.q: All important files must ___ before the computer is repaired.

back up: back up es activo; después de must be va el participio: be backed up.
been backed up: después de un modal va be, no been: must be backed up.
being backed up: después de un modal va be, no being: must be backed up.

items.q: A new algorithm ___ by the research team at the moment.

is developing: is developing es activo; el algoritmo recibe la acción (pasivo): is being developed.
is developed: is developed es presente simple pasivo; at the moment pide continuo: is being developed.
has developed: has developed es activo; hace falta pasivo continuo: is being developed.

items.q: The problem should ___ as soon as possible.

solve: solve es activo; después de should be va el participio: be solved.
been solved: después de un modal va be, no been: should be solved.
being solved: después de un modal va be, no being: should be solved.

items.q: This programming language ___ by developers all over the world.

uses: uses es activo; el lenguaje es usado (pasivo): is used.
has used: has used es activo; hace falta pasivo: is used.
is using: is using es activo; el lenguaje recibe la acción: is used.

items.q: The new application ___ by our development team last month.
items.e: last month → Past Simple pasivo: was + participio.

is developed: is developed es presente; last month pide pasado: was developed.
developed: developed solo sería activo; la aplicación fue desarrollada (pasivo): was developed.
has developed: has developed es activo; hace falta pasivo en pasado: was developed.

items.q: The bug ___ yet.
items.e: 'yet' → Present Perfect pasivo: hasn't been + participio. (Tu Test 5 #27: 'hasn't fixed' no lleva been.)

hasn't fixed: hasn't fixed es activo; el bug recibe la acción (pasivo): hasn't been fixed.
isn't fixed: isn't fixed es presente simple pasivo; yet pide presente perfecto: hasn't been fixed.
wasn't fixing: wasn't fixing es activo continuo; hace falta pasivo perfecto: hasn't been fixed.

items.q: The problem ___ during the testing process yesterday.

discovered: discovered solo sería activo; el problema fue descubierto (pasivo): was discovered.
is discovered: is discovered es presente; yesterday pide pasado: was discovered.
has discovered: has discovered es activo; hace falta pasivo en pasado: was discovered.

items.q: More than 500 users ___ by the technical support team so far.

have helped: have helped es activo; los usuarios reciben la ayuda (pasivo): have been helped.
were helped: were helped es pasado simple; so far pide presente perfecto: have been helped.
are helped: are helped es presente simple; so far pide presente perfecto: have been helped.

items.q: Several improvements ___ to the application since January.

have made: have made es activo; las mejoras son hechas (pasivo): have been made.
were made: were made es pasado simple; since January pide presente perfecto: have been made.
are made: are made es presente simple; since January pide presente perfecto: have been made.

items.q: The computer ___ before the technician arrived.
items.e: Antes de otro evento pasado → Past Perfect pasivo.

was repaired: was repaired es pasado simple; before the technician arrived pide past perfect: had been repaired.
has been repaired: has been repaired es presente perfecto; la frase está en pasado: had been repaired.
had repaired: had repaired es activo; la computadora recibe la acción (pasivo): had been repaired.

items.q: The final report ___ by Friday.

will complete: will complete es activo; el informe es completado (pasivo): will have been completed.
will be completing: will be completing es activo continuo; con by Friday y pasivo: will have been completed.
has completed: has completed es activo y presente; hace falta futuro perfecto pasivo: will have been completed.

items.q: The data ___ from the old system to the new one yesterday.

transferred: transferred solo sería activo; los datos fueron transferidos (pasivo): was transferred.
is transferred: is transferred es presente; yesterday pide pasado: was transferred.
has transferred: has transferred es activo; hace falta pasivo en pasado: was transferred.

title: Passive Voice: un verbo, todos los tiempos
instructions: Escribí la forma pasiva de take / finish / send en el tiempo que indica cada oración.
text:
1. The photos [1] (take) every day.
2. The photos [2] (take) right now.
3. The photos [3] (take) already.
4. The photos [4] (take) yesterday.
5. The photos [5] (take) when the phone rang.
6. The photos [6] (take) before anyone noticed.
7. The photos [7] (take) tomorrow.
8. The photos [8] (take) by Friday.
9. The report [9] (finish) yesterday.
10. Emails [10] (send) every morning.

pat: el pasivo lleva be + participio: are taken.
have taken es activo; las fotos reciben la acción: are taken.
right now pide presente continuo pasivo: are being taken.
are taking es activo; las fotos reciben la acción: are being taken.
el continuo pasivo es are being + participio: are being taken.
have taken es activo; las fotos reciben la acción: have been taken.
already pide presente perfecto: have been taken.
después de been va el participio: taken.
el participio de take es taken (take → took → taken): were taken.
took es activo; las fotos reciben la acción: were taken.
when the phone rang interrumpe una acción en progreso: were being taken.
were taking es activo; las fotos reciben la acción: were being taken.
before anyone noticed pide past perfect: had been taken.
had taken es activo; las fotos reciben la acción: had been taken.
will take es activo; las fotos reciben la acción: will be taken.
el futuro pasivo es will be + participio: will be taken.
by Friday pide futuro perfecto pasivo: will have been taken.
will have taken es activo; las fotos reciben la acción: will have been taken.
the report es singular: was finished.
el pasivo lleva participio: was finished.
finished solo sería activo; el informe fue terminado: was finished.
el participio de send es sent (send → sent → sent): are sent.
send es activo; los emails reciben la acción: are sent.

title: De activa a pasiva
instructions: Pasá cada oración a pasiva completando el hueco (el sujeto de la pasiva es el objeto de la activa).
text:
1. The team is testing the new feature. → The new feature [1] by the team.
2. Someone has deleted the file. → The file [2].
3. They will launch the app on Monday. → The app [3] on Monday.
4. They had repaired the server before I arrived. → The server [4] before I arrived.
5. The developers must fix the bug today. → The bug [5] today.
6. Someone should have told him the truth. → He [6] the truth.
7. They were fixing the bug when I called. → The bug [7] when I called.
8. Steve Jobs created Apple. → Apple [8] by Steve Jobs.

pat: la activa está en presente continuo (is testing): la pasiva también: is being tested.
is testing es activo; la pasiva lleva be + participio: is being tested.
has deleted es activo; el archivo recibe la acción: has been deleted.
la activa está en presente perfecto (has deleted): la pasiva también: has been deleted.
el participio de delete es deleted: has been deleted.
will launch es activo; la app recibe la acción: will be launched.
el futuro pasivo es will be + participio: will be launched.
la activa está en past perfect (had repaired): la pasiva también: had been repaired.
had repaired es activo; el servidor recibe la acción: had been repaired.
must fix es activo; el bug recibe la acción: must be fixed.
el pasivo con modal es modal + be + participio: must be fixed.
must have been fixed es deducción sobre el pasado; la activa es presente (must fix): must be fixed.
should have told habla del pasado (reproche); la pasiva también: should have been told.
should have told es activo; él recibe la acción: should have been told.
el participio de tell es told: should have been told.
items.e: Tu apunte: modal + have been + participio (He should have been told the truth).

pat: la activa está en pasado continuo (were fixing): la pasiva también: was being fixed.
the bug es singular: was being fixed.
was fixing es activo; el bug recibe la acción: was being fixed.
created solo sería activo; Apple recibe la acción: was created.
el pasivo lleva participio: was created.
items.e: Tu apunte: Apple was created by Steve Jobs.

title: ¿Qué tiempo pasivo es?
instructions: Elegí el tiempo verbal (en voz pasiva) de la parte en negrita.

items.q: The photos **are taken** every day.

Present Continuous passive: Present Continuous passive = am/is/are + being + participio (ocurre ahora). Acá tenés are taken.
Present Perfect passive: Present Perfect passive = have/has + been + participio (pasado conectado con el presente). Acá tenés are taken.
Past Simple passive: Past Simple passive = was/were + participio (pasado terminado). Acá tenés are taken.
Past Perfect passive: Past Perfect passive = had + been + participio (antes de otro momento del pasado). Acá tenés are taken.
Future passive: Future passive = will + be + participio (futuro). Acá tenés are taken.

items.q: The photos **are being taken** now.

Present Simple passive: Present Simple passive = am/is/are + participio (hábito o hecho general). Acá tenés are being taken.
Present Perfect passive: Present Perfect passive = have/has + been + participio (pasado conectado con el presente). Acá tenés are being taken.
Past Simple passive: Past Simple passive = was/were + participio (pasado terminado). Acá tenés are being taken.
Past Perfect passive: Past Perfect passive = had + been + participio (antes de otro momento del pasado). Acá tenés are being taken.
Future passive: Future passive = will + be + participio (futuro). Acá tenés are being taken.

items.q: The photos **have been taken**.

Present Simple passive: Present Simple passive = am/is/are + participio (hábito o hecho general). Acá tenés have been taken.
Present Continuous passive: Present Continuous passive = am/is/are + being + participio (ocurre ahora). Acá tenés have been taken.
Past Simple passive: Past Simple passive = was/were + participio (pasado terminado). Acá tenés have been taken.
Past Perfect passive: Past Perfect passive = had + been + participio (antes de otro momento del pasado). Acá tenés have been taken.
Future passive: Future passive = will + be + participio (futuro). Acá tenés have been taken.

items.q: The photos **were taken** yesterday.

Present Simple passive: Present Simple passive = am/is/are + participio (hábito o hecho general). Acá tenés were taken.
Present Continuous passive: Present Continuous passive = am/is/are + being + participio (ocurre ahora). Acá tenés were taken.
Present Perfect passive: Present Perfect passive = have/has + been + participio (pasado conectado con el presente). Acá tenés were taken.
Past Perfect passive: Past Perfect passive = had + been + participio (antes de otro momento del pasado). Acá tenés were taken.
Future passive: Future passive = will + be + participio (futuro). Acá tenés were taken.

items.q: The photos **had been taken** before we arrived.

Present Simple passive: Present Simple passive = am/is/are + participio (hábito o hecho general). Acá tenés had been taken.
Present Continuous passive: Present Continuous passive = am/is/are + being + participio (ocurre ahora). Acá tenés had been taken.
Present Perfect passive: Present Perfect passive = have/has + been + participio (pasado conectado con el presente). Acá tenés had been taken.
Past Simple passive: Past Simple passive = was/were + participio (pasado terminado). Acá tenés had been taken.
Future passive: Future passive = will + be + participio (futuro). Acá tenés had been taken.

items.q: The photos **will be taken** tomorrow.

Present Simple passive: Present Simple passive = am/is/are + participio (hábito o hecho general). Acá tenés will be taken.
Present Continuous passive: Present Continuous passive = am/is/are + being + participio (ocurre ahora). Acá tenés will be taken.
Present Perfect passive: Present Perfect passive = have/has + been + participio (pasado conectado con el presente). Acá tenés will be taken.
Past Simple passive: Past Simple passive = was/were + participio (pasado terminado). Acá tenés will be taken.
Past Perfect passive: Past Perfect passive = had + been + participio (antes de otro momento del pasado). Acá tenés will be taken.

items.q: The cake **was made** by my mom.

Present Simple passive: Present Simple passive = am/is/are + participio (hábito o hecho general). Acá tenés was made.
Present Continuous passive: Present Continuous passive = am/is/are + being + participio (ocurre ahora). Acá tenés was made.
Present Perfect passive: Present Perfect passive = have/has + been + participio (pasado conectado con el presente). Acá tenés was made.
Past Perfect passive: Past Perfect passive = had + been + participio (antes de otro momento del pasado). Acá tenés was made.
Future passive: Future passive = will + be + participio (futuro). Acá tenés was made.

items.q: The TV **is being watched** by my brother.

Present Simple passive: Present Simple passive = am/is/are + participio (hábito o hecho general). Acá tenés is being watched.
Present Perfect passive: Present Perfect passive = have/has + been + participio (pasado conectado con el presente). Acá tenés is being watched.
Past Simple passive: Past Simple passive = was/were + participio (pasado terminado). Acá tenés is being watched.
Past Perfect passive: Past Perfect passive = had + been + participio (antes de otro momento del pasado). Acá tenés is being watched.
Future passive: Future passive = will + be + participio (futuro). Acá tenés is being watched.

items.q: Everyone **has been told** to stay inside.

Present Simple passive: Present Simple passive = am/is/are + participio (hábito o hecho general). Acá tenés has been told.
Present Continuous passive: Present Continuous passive = am/is/are + being + participio (ocurre ahora). Acá tenés has been told.
Past Simple passive: Past Simple passive = was/were + participio (pasado terminado). Acá tenés has been told.
Past Perfect passive: Past Perfect passive = had + been + participio (antes de otro momento del pasado). Acá tenés has been told.
Future passive: Future passive = will + be + participio (futuro). Acá tenés has been told.

title: Passive con dos objetos
instructions: Elegí la pasiva que empieza por el objeto pedido. (Para el examen: probablemente pidan empezar por el objeto directo.)

items.q: My teacher gave us homework. Pasiva que empieza por el objeto DIRECTO (homework):
items.e: Objeto directo como sujeto → Homework was given to us.

es una pasiva correcta, pero empieza por el objeto INDIRECTO (us → We). El ejercicio pide empezar por el directo (homework): Homework was given to us.
us es pronombre objeto; como sujeto de la pasiva es we.
gave es activo, y daría a entender que la tarea dio algo a nosotros.

items.q: My teacher gave us homework. Pasiva que empieza por el objeto INDIRECTO (us):
items.e: Objeto indirecto como sujeto → We were given homework.

es una pasiva correcta, pero empieza por el objeto DIRECTO (homework). El ejercicio pide empezar por el indirecto (us → We): We were given homework.
us es pronombre objeto; como sujeto de la pasiva es we.
después de were va el participio: given.

items.q: The company sent the clients an invoice. Pasiva que empieza por el objeto directo:
o: An invoice was sent to the clients.
The clients were sent an invoice.
items.a: An invoice was sent to the clients.
items.e: An invoice (objeto directo) + was sent to...

es una pasiva correcta, pero empieza por el objeto INDIRECTO (the clients). El ejercicio pide empezar por el directo (an invoice): An invoice was sent to the clients.
es activo, y cambia el sentido: los clientes serían quienes enviaron la factura.
es activo, y cambia el sentido: la factura sería la que envió a los clientes.

items.q: They offered her a new job. Pasiva que empieza por 'She':
o: She was offered a new job.
She was offering a new job.
items.a: She was offered a new job.
items.e: Objeto indirecto como sujeto → She was offered a new job.

es activo y cambia el sentido: el trabajo la ofrecería a ella.
es activo: ella sería quien ofrece el trabajo.
es activo continuo: ella estaría ofreciendo el trabajo.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: The windows have cleaned every week.
The windows are cleaned every week.
items.a: The windows are cleaned every week.
items.e: La pasiva usa be, no have.

have cleaned es activo; las ventanas reciben la acción: are cleaned.
falta el verbo be: are cleaned.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:

después de be va el participio: finished.
orden incorrecto; be va antes del participio: is finished.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:

are sent es presente; yesterday pide pasado: were sent.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: The photos have been being taken.
items.e: El Perfect Continuous no tiene pasiva natural: reformulá con Present Perfect.

se mezclan perfecto y continuo; el presente perfecto pasivo es have been taken.

items.q: Elegí la pasiva correcta (they = los invitados):
o: Were they invited to the wedding?
Did they invited to the wedding?
Was they invited to the wedding?
items.a: Were they invited to the wedding?
items.e: Cualquier sujeto puede recibir la acción, también they.

Did they invited to the wedding?: did va con verbo base y la pasiva se arma con be: Were they invited?

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: The server is being monitored at the moment.
The server is monitoring at the moment.
The server is been monitored at the moment.
items.a: The server is being monitored at the moment.

is monitoring es activo; el servidor recibe la acción: is being monitored.
The server is been monitored at the mome: el continuo pasivo es is being + participio, no is been.

title: Passive con modales y voz impersonal

items.q: They ___ there for observation.
items.e: Tu apunte: They will be kept there for observation.

will keep: will keep es activo; ellos reciben la acción: will be kept.
will been kept: después de will va be, no been: will be kept.
will be keeping: will be keeping es activo continuo; hace falta pasivo: will be kept.

items.q: He ___ asked to leave, I think. Nobody saw him after the meeting.
items.e: Deducción sobre el pasado + pasiva → must have been + participio.

must be: must be asked habla del presente; la deducción es sobre el pasado (nobody saw him after the meeting): must have been asked.
must have: falta been: must have been asked.
must been: falta have: must have been asked.

items.q: These files ___ before the update.

must back up: must back up es activo; los archivos reciben la acción: must be backed up.
must be back up: después de be va el participio: backed up.
must to be backed up: después de un modal no va to: must be backed up.

items.q: The manager should ___ told about the delay yesterday.
items.e: should have been told (crítica pasada + pasiva).

be: yesterday pide pasado: should have been told.
been: falta have: should have been told.
have: falta been: should have been told.

items.q: By next week, the whole system ___.
items.e: By + tiempo futuro → Future Perfect pasivo.

will be migrating: will be migrating es activo continuo; con by next week y pasivo: will have been migrated.
will have migrated: will have migrated es activo; el sistema recibe la acción: will have been migrated.
has been migrated: has been migrated es presente perfecto; By next week pide futuro: will have been migrated.

items.q: It ___ that new investment will generate employment.
items.e: Tu apunte: It is hoped that...

hopes: hopes es activo; la voz impersonal usa pasiva: It is hoped that...
is hoping: is hoping es activo continuo; la voz impersonal usa pasiva: It is hoped that...
has hope: has hope no forma una pasiva: It is hoped.

items.q: It ___ that procedures be reviewed.
items.e: Tu apunte: It is recommended that...

recommends: recommends es activo; la voz impersonal usa pasiva: It is recommended that...
is recommending: is recommending es activo continuo; la voz impersonal usa pasiva: It is recommended.
recommended it: el orden de la pasiva impersonal es It is recommended that...
